definition: to find the size or measurements of something
description: A sunny back garden with a family party going on: picnic tables set with food and cups, and grown-ups and children all over the lawn. A boy and a blonde girl run towards each other across the grass and hug tightly, laughing into the camera. They then stand back to back, chins up, and an adult lays a flat ruler across the tops of their two heads to see which of them is taller. Other children run past behind them.

en.question: What is resting on their heads?

de.answer: Ein Lineal liegt auf ihren Köpfen.
de.question: Was liegt auf ihren Köpfen?

es.answer: Una regla está descansando sobre sus cabezas.
es.question: ¿Qué está descansando sobre sus cabezas?

fr.answer: Une règle repose sur leurs têtes.
phrases: serrer fort le garçon dans ses bras
fr.question: Qu'est-ce qui repose sur leurs têtes ?
